question: What conduct should a practitioner with an equal mind adopt through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an equal mind
Village customs are presented as something to relinquish
The verse prescribes abandonment of those customs
inference: Through practice, one with an equal mind should abandon village customs
uncertainties: grāma-dharmañ may refer broadly to conventional social duties
plain_english: Through practice, with an even mind, one should abandon the customs of village life.
